author: Prometheus III
title: Prometheus III: Seed-Nudge-Refine Pipeline v1.2 (Wide Search)
abstract: This experiment tests the hypothesis that search breadth is more critical than depth for the 'Seed-Nudge-Refine' pipeline. Based on the positive trend from Eval 724, this version dramatically increases the number of initial seeds from 16 to 48. To manage runtime, the final refinement stage's max iterations are reduced. The goal is to more thoroughly explore the solution space in the hope that one of the many nudged candidates will fall into a superior basin of attraction.
